Title: 1. Blazing Saddles
description: In order to ruin a western town and steal their land, a corrupt politician appoints a black sheriff, who promptly becomes his most formidable adversary.

Title: 2. The Towering Inferno
description: At the opening party of a colossal San Francisco skyscraper, a massive fire breaks out due to careless building practices by the contractor, threatening to destroy the tower and everyone in it.

Title: 3. Young Frankenstein
description: An American grandson of the infamous scientist, struggling to prove that his grandfather was not as insane as people believe, is invited to Transylvania, where he discovers the process that reanimates a dead body.

Title: 4. Earthquake
description: Various interconnected people struggle to survive when an earthquake of unimaginable magnitude hits Los Angeles, California.

Title: 5. The Godfather Part II
description: The early life and career of Vito Corleone in 1920s New York City is portrayed, while his son, Michael, expands and tightens his grip on the family crime syndicate.

Title: 6. The Longest Yard
description: A sadistic warden asks a former pro quarterback, now serving time in his prison, to put together a team of inmates to take on (and get pummeled by) the guards.

Title: 7. Benji
description: A stray dog saves two kidnapped children.

Title: 8. Herbie Rides Again
description: The living Volkswagen Beetle helps an old lady protect her home from a corrupt developer.

Title: 9. The Texas Chain Saw Massacre
description: Five friends head out to rural Texas to visit the grave of a grandfather. On the way they stumble across what appears to be a deserted house, only to discover something sinister within. Something armed with a chainsaw.

Title: 10. Chinatown
description: A private detective hired to expose an adulterer in 1930s Los Angeles finds himself caught up in a web of deceit, corruption, and murder.

Title: 11. Murder on the Orient Express
description: Returning home from Istanbul on the Orient Express, renowned Belgian detective Hercule Poirot is called upon to solve the murder of an American businessman aboard the train. The suspects are numerous and the clues confusing.

Title: 12. That's Entertainment!
description: Various MGM stars from yesteryear present their favorite musical moments from the studio's 50-year history.

Title: 13. Death Wish
description: A New York City architect becomes a one-man vigilante squad after his wife is murdered by street punks. In self-defense, the vengeful man kills muggers on the mean streets after dark.

Title: 14. Thunderbolt and Lightfoot
description: With the help of an irreverent young sidekick, a bank robber gets his old gang back together to organize a daring new heist.

Title: 15. The Man with the Golden Gun
description: James Bond is targeted by the world's most expensive assassin, while he attempts to recover sensitive solar cell technology that is being sold to the highest bidder.

Title: 16. The Great Gatsby
description: A Midwesterner becomes fascinated with his nouveau riche neighbor, who obsesses over his lost love.

Title: 17. Alice Doesn't Live Here Anymore
description: A recently-widowed woman is on the road with her precocious young son, determined to make a new life for herself as a singer.

Title: 18. The Sugarland Express
description: A woman attempts to reunite her family by helping her husband escape prison and together kidnapping their son. But things don't go as planned when they are forced to take a police hostage on the road.

Title: 19. The Conversation
description: A paranoid, secretive surveillance expert has a crisis of conscience when he suspects that the couple he is spying on will be murdered.

Title: 20. A Poem Is a Naked Person
description: Les Blank's first feature-length documentary captures music and other events at Leon Russell's Oklahoma recording studio during a three-year period (1972-1974).

Title: 21. Swept Away
description: A trip into the Mediterranean sea becomes a trip into the discovery of how society's frameworks of the rich and poor are delicate and temporary.

Title: 22. Celine and Julie Go Boating
description: Two women enter a mysterious house where a story endlessly repeats-and try to change its outcome.

Title: 23. Hearts and Minds
description: A startling and courageous landmark documentary that unflinchingly confronted the United States' involvement in Vietnam at the height of the controversy that surrounded it.

Title: 24. Conversation Piece
description: A reclusive retired professor is faced with confronting modernity when a group of vulgar youths led by an obnoxious marchesa take up residence in his unused upper residence.

Title: 25. The Devil Queen
description: Crime queen and drug dealer, Diaba finds out that the police are after his protégé and decides to "make up" a new bandit to turn in in his place.

Title: 26. Stavisky
description: A swindler's activity indirectly caused a political crisis in France in the last years before World War II.

Title: 27. Stranger and the Fog
description: In a remote Iranian village, a boat arrives with a wounded man, Ayat, who has amnesia. Widow Ra'na is interested in him, causing family tensions. Villagers ask Ayat to marry, but he chooses Ra'na, leading to trouble.

Title: 28. Fear Eats the Soul
description: A woman in her 60s falls in love with a man in his 30s.

Title: 29. Effi Briest
description: 17-year-old Effi Briest is forced into a loveless marriage with the elderly Baron von Instetten. Living as the aristocrat's trophy wife, Effi endures her provincial existence unhappily. Because of her husband's constant traveling.

Title: 30. The Phantom of Liberty
description: A series of surreal sequences that critique morality and society in a stream of consciousness style.

Title: 31. Vincent, François, Paul and the Others
description: Three friends face mid-life crises. Paul is a writer who's blocked. François has lost his ideals and practices medicine for the money. The charming Vincent faces bankruptcy and his wife, from whom he's separated, wants a divorce.

Title: 32. Promised Lands
description: This is Susan Sontag's documentary about Israel, shot during the Yom Kippur war. Much of it is strictly observational.

Title: 33. Phantom of the Paradise
description: After an evil record producer betrays him and steals his music to open a lavish rock palace, a disfigured composer sells his soul so that only the woman he loves can perform his work.

Title: 34. Black Christmas
description: During their Christmas break, a group of sorority girls are stalked by a stranger.

Title: 35. A Woman Under the Influence
description: The loving wife of a blue-collar boss somehow crosses the line from quirkiness to madness.

Title: 36. Zardoz
description: In the late 23rd century, a savage trained only to kill finds a way into the community of bored immortals that alone preserves humanity's achievements.

Title: 37. The Taking of Pelham One Two Three
description: Four armed men hijack a New York City subway car and demand a ransom for the passengers. The city's police are faced with a conundrum: Even if it's paid, how could they get away?

Title: 38. Emmanuelle
description: The wife of a French diplomat in Bangkok embarks on a voyage of self-discovery.

Title: 39. Dark Star
description: In the far reaches of space, a small crew, 20 years into their solitary mission, find things beginning to go hilariously wrong.

Title: 40. The Night Porter
description: A concentration camp survivor rekindles her sadomasochistic relationship with an ex-SS officer working as a night porter at a Vienna hotel, but his former associates begin stalking them.

Title: 41. Harry and Tonto
description: When his apartment building is torn down, a retired lifelong New Yorker goes on a cross-country odyssey with his beloved cat Tonto.

Title: 42. Lenny
description: The story of acerbic 1960s comic Lenny Bruce, whose groundbreaking, no-holds-barred style and social commentary was often deemed by the Establishment as too obscene for the public.

Title: 43. Phase IV
description: Suddenly, desert ants form a group intelligence and wage war on the humans. It's up to a couple of scientists and a girl to stop them

Title: 44. Scenes from a Marriage
description: Chronicles the many years of love and turmoil that bind Marianne and Johan through matrimony, infidelity, divorce, and subsequent partners.

Title: 45. The Four Musketeers
description: The Four Musketeers defend the queen and her dressmaker from Cardinal Richelieu and Milady de Winter.

Title: 46. Foxy Brown
description: A vigilante takes a job as a high-class prostitute to get revenge on the mobsters who murdered her boyfriend.

Title: 47. Arabian Nights
description: In ancient Arabia, a beautiful slave girl chooses a youth to be her new master, then she is kidnapped and they must search for each other. Stories are told within stories: love, travel and the whims of destiny.

Title: 48. Airport 1975
description: A 747 in flight collides with a small plane, and is rendered pilotless. Somehow the control tower must get a pilot aboard so the jet can land.

Title: 49. Alice in the Cities
description: A German journalist is saddled with a nine-year-old girl after encountering her mother at a New York airport.

Title: 50. The Parallax View
description: An ambitious reporter gets in way-over-his-head trouble while investigating a senator's assassination which leads to a vast conspiracy involving a multinational corporation behind every event in the world's headlines.

Title: 51. The Yakuza
description: American private-eye Harry Kilmer returns to Japan to rescue a friend's kidnapped daughter from the clutches of the Yakuza.

Title: 52. Female Trouble
description: A spoiled schoolgirl runs away from home, gets pregnant while hitch-hiking, and ends up as a fashion model for a pair of beauticians who like to photograph women committing crimes.

Title: 53. Going Places
description: Two thugs travel around France terrorizing their compatriots.

Title: 54. Messiah of Evil
description: A young woman goes searching for her missing artist father. Her journey takes her to a strange Californian seaside town governed by a mysterious undead cult.

Title: 55. Let Sleeping Corpses Lie
description: After a chance meeting while traveling the countryside, a man and a woman become suspected of murder. They start to leave a lot of dead bodies in their wake, but, unbeknownst to the police, the real culprits are living dead zombies.

Title: 56. The Ghost Galleon
description: The living corpses of the Satan-worshiping Knights Templar hunt for human victims in a 16th century galleon.

Title: 57. The Odessa File
description: Following the suicide of an elderly Jewish man, a journalist in possession of the man's diary investigates the alleged sighting of a former S.S. Captain, who commanded a concentration camp during World War II.

Title: 58. We All Loved Each Other So Much
description: Three partisans bound by a strong friendship return home after the war, but the clash with everyday reality puts a strain on their bond.

Title: 59. Big Bad Mama
description: Circumstances force a tough single mother and her two daughters into a life of crime and they quickly become outlaws on the run, picking up partners along the way, and traveling to different states, pursued by the law.

Title: 60. Sweet Movie
description: In this surreal story, a naive woman flees a loveless marriage to experience the world around her and meets all kinds of characters.

Title: 61. Gone in 60 Seconds
description: An insurance investigator moonlighting as a car thief must steal 48 cars in five days.

Title: 62. Flesh Gordon
description: Emperor Wang is leader of the planet Porno and sends his mighty sex ray toward Earth, which turns everyone into sex-mad fiends. Only one person can save the Earth, football player Flesh Gordon.

Title: 63. Bring Me the Head of Alfredo Garcia
description: An American barroom pianist and his prostitute girlfriend go on a trip through the Mexican underworld to collect the bounty on the head of a dead gigolo.

Title: 64. Appassionata
description: A married dentist gets embroiled in a sexual affair with his teenage daughter's best friend. Meanwhile, his wife's mental health is deteriorating, and his daughter is desperate for an affair of her own.

Title: 65. The Land That Time Forgot
description: During World War I, a German U-boat sinks a British ship and takes the survivors on board. After it takes a wrong turn, the submarine takes them to the unknown land of Caprona, where they find dinosaurs and neanderthals.

Title: 66. The Lords of Flatbush
description: Two members of a social club in 1950s Brooklyn have more interest in romance than in rumbles.

Title: 67. Watch Out, We're Mad
description: After a tied first place in a local stunt race, two drivers start a contest to decide which of them will own the prize, a dune buggy. But when a mobster destroys the car, they are determined to get it back.

Title: 68. Captain Kronos: Vampire Hunter
description: A master swordsman and former soldier and his hunchbacked assistant hunt vampires.

Title: 69. Lacombe, Lucien
description: In 1944, an 18-year-old boy from small-town France collaborates with the Gestapo and subsequently falls in love with a Jewish girl.

Title: 70. The Enigma of Kaspar Hauser
description: A young man named Kaspar Hauser suddenly appears in Nuremberg in 1828, barely able to talk or walk, and bearing a strange note.

Title: 71. The Gambler
description: Literature professor Axel Freed is a gambling addict. When he has lost his money, he borrows from his girlfriend Billie, then his mother Naomi, and finally some criminals that chase him. Despite all of this, he cannot stop gambling.

Title: 72. Claudine
description: In the 1970s Harlem, garbage collector Roop feels intimidated by the idea of dating Claudine who is a single mother of six on welfare.

Title: 73. Video Vixens!
description: A wild TV executive makes a prudish film critic host a scandalous live awards show for adult films, complete with risqué commercials.

Title: 74. Godzilla vs. Mechagodzilla
description: An Okinawan prophecy appears to foretell Earth's destruction at the hands of Godzilla, only for the true Godzilla to reveal his doppelganger as a mechanical alien weapon.

Title: 75. Juggernaut
description: A blackmailer demands a huge ransom in exchange for information on how to disarm the seven bombs he placed aboard the transatlantic liner Britannic.

Title: 76. From Beyond the Grave
description: An anthology of four short horror stories revolving around a mysterious antique shop owner and his antique pieces, each of which hides a deadly secret.

Title: 77. The Man Who Sleeps
description: A 25-year-old male student in Paris becomes indifferent to the world around him, and subsequently feels a strong sense of alienation and hopelessness.

Title: 78. Frankenstein and the Monster from Hell
description: Baron Frankenstein works with a mental patient to reanimate the dead.

Title: 79. Deep Throat Part II
description: When one of sex therapist extraordinaire Linda's patients turns out to be harboring the plans to a top-secret government computer, both the KGB and the CIA attempt to enlist Linda in their efforts to steal the data.

Title: 80. The Front Page
description: A ruthless editor tries to get his top reporter to cover one more crime story before retirement.

Title: 81. The Terminal Man
description: Hoping to cure his blackout seizures which turn him temporarily extremely violent, a computer scientist agrees to an experimental brain computer chip implant surgery.

Title: 82. The Devil in Miss Jonas
description: Miss Jonas, prone to a decadent life, has been sentenced to death. In Hell, she is told she's three days early and therefore sent back to life. Her friends are confused but expecting Hell anyway, she's determined to really deserve it.

Title: 83. From the Village to the City
description: The sequel of Salak Milyoner. The adventure continues in Ankara when four brothers find a hoard full of gold while working in the plantation.

Title: 84. It's Alive
description: The Davises are expecting a baby, which turns out to be a monster with a nasty habit of killing people whenever it is scared. And it is easily scared.

Title: 85. Madhouse
description: A horror movie star returns to his famous role after years in a mental institution. But the character seems to be committing murders independent of his will.

Title: 86. Scent of a Woman
description: A young private is assigned to accompany a blind captain. It soon becomes clear that they are both complex personalities.

Title: 87. McQ
description: Seattle cop is caught up in a corrupt police force that he is trying to make right. McQ is a cop with a mission.

Title: 88. The Teacher
description: An explosively tense story about a beautiful, provocative 28-year-old high school teacher whose seduction of one particular student proves fatal.

Title: 89. Dirty Mary Crazy Larry
description: Down-on-their-luck racers Larry and Deke steal from a supermarket manager to buy a car that will help them advance their racing chances. Their escape does not go as planned when Larry's one-night stand, Mary, tags along for the ride.

Title: 90. The Legend of the 7 Golden Vampires
description: In China, Professor Van Helsing helps eight kung fu-trained siblings reclaim their ancestral mountain village, now the domain of seven powerful vampires and their army of undead slaves.

Title: 91. Vampyres
description: A pair of women lure passers-by to their countryside mansion to feed on them to satisfy their need for blood.

Title: 92. Mahler
description: Composer Gustav Mahler's (Robert Powell) life, told in a series of flashbacks as he and his wife (Georgina Hale) discuss their failing marriage during a train journey.

Title: 93. Lancelot of the Lake
description: King Arthur learns that his wife, Queen Guinevere, has been having an affair with Lancelot, who at the same time remains loyal to the king, particularly after Arthur's traitorous nephew Mordred commits an attempt on his life.

Title: 94. Almost Human
description: An insecure small-time crook with homicidal tendencies kidnaps a young heiress, prompting a cop to pursue him before he can kill the girl once the hefty ransom is paid.

Title: 95. Dark Places
description: After the original owner dies in a mental asylum, a man moves into an abandoned mansion with a sordid history. Meanwhile, a few locals conspire to steal a large amount of money, said to be hidden somewhere on the premises.

Title: 96. Old Dracula
description: In order to revive his long hibernating bride, Vampira, Count Dracula takes blood samples from several beautiful models, but during the transfusion, Vampira's race turns from white to black.

Title: 97. The Nickel Ride
description: In Los Angeles, a criminal begins to think that his accomplices want to get rid of him.

Title: 98. Italianamerican
description: Martin Scorsese interviews his mother and father about their life in New York City and the family history back in Sicily. These are two people who have lived together for a long time and know each other very well.

Title: 99. The Terrorists
description: In a Scandinavian country, national security chief Colonel Tahlvik is tasked to rescue the passengers of a hijacked British airliner while the British Ambassador is being held hostage at his residence by another terrorist team.

Title: 100. Coonskin
description: A streetwise trickster muscles into Harlem's organized crime scene, clashing with a racist mob and corrupt cops.

Title: 101. And Now My Love
description: From 1918 to 2000, Sarah is a young woman unlucky in love. Her life takes a new turn the day she meets Simon. The young couple wishes to have a child, but by the year 2000, procreation is no longer free due to excessive pollution.

Title: 102. Confessions of a Window Cleaner
description: A young and clumsy window cleaner working for his brother-in-law begins to realize that "full service" goes beyond just cleaning windows. Soon, he meets and becomes infatuated with a young female police officer.

Title: 103. The Little Prince
description: A pilot, stranded in the desert, meets a little boy who is a prince on a planet.

Title: 104. The Mutations
description: A rogue biologist abducts students to accelerate evolution through genetic hybridization. He grafts botanical traits onto human subjects within a secluded laboratory while employing a disfigured assistant to procure fresh biological stock.

Title: 105. Innocence and Desire
description: A young man is temporarily home from a Seminary, but eventually falls in love with his father's young new wife.

Title: 106. I, You, He, She
description: 'Je' is a girl voluntarily lock up in a room. 'Tu' is the script. 'Il' is a lorry driver. 'Elle' is the girlfriend.

Title: 107. Dead of Night
description: A young soldier killed in the Vietnam War inexplicably shows up at his family home on the night of his death.

Title: 108. Caged Heat
description: In a women's prison, a group of inmates band together to combat the repressive and abusive policies of the crippled female warden and the corrupt prison doctor.

Title: 109. The Arena
description: When the Romans force a group of sex slaves to become gladiatrices, two such fighters - a Nubian dancer and a Gaulish priestess - form an alliance to lead the others in rebellion.

Title: 110. Beyond the Door
description: Pregnant with her third child, an English mother in San Francisco starts exhibiting erratic and violent behavior, and talking in a deep, almost demonic voice. An old friend from the past arrives, claiming that he has all the answers.

Title: 111. My Little Loves
description: A boy is left to his own devices when his mother refuses to pay for his schooling.

Title: 112. 2069: A Sex Odyssey
description: Five sexy females from the planet Venus are sent to Earth to bring back sperm samples to their planet. In Bavaria they use machines to extract the samples from resisting males but soon learn that sex is an easier way to get what they want.

Title: 113. California Split
description: When casual gambler Bill Denny befriends professional gambler Charlie Walters, Bill begins to mirror Charlie's life, sinking deeper and deeper into the sleazy world of gambling, where the stakes keep getting bigger.

Title: 114. Successive Slidings of Pleasure
description: A cult erotic drama from the perverse imagination of Alain Robbe-Grillet, SUCCESSIVE SLIDINGS OF PLEASURE delves into the twisted mind of a young woman suspected in the stabbing death of her roommate Nora.

Title: 115. The Perfume of the Lady in Black
description: Sylvia, an industrial scientist, is troubled by strange hallucinations related to the tragic suicide of her mother.

Title: 116. Thieves Like Us
description: When two men break out of prison, they join up with another and restart their criminal ways, robbing banks across the South.

Title: 117. Flower and Snake
description: The elderly Senzô Tôyama orders his employee, Makoto Katagiri, to kidnap and train his wife Shizuko in order to break her pride so that she will submit to his desires.

Title: 118. Rabid Dogs
description: Following a bungled robbery, three violent criminals take a young woman, a middle-aged man, and a child hostage and force them to drive them outside Rome to help them make a clean escape.

Title: 119. Frightmare
description: After escaping a death sentence for her hideous crimes, a seemingly rehabilitated woman settles in an isolated farmhouse with her husband, only to ache, once more, for blood, and a crash-course in surgery. Is, indeed, her old self back?

Title: 120. Pastoral: To Die in the Country
description: A young boys' coming of age tale set in a strange, carnivalesque village becomes the recreation of a memory that the director has twenty years later.

Title: 121. The Groove Tube
description: A collection of skits that make fun of 1970s television, featuring early appearances by Chevy Chase and Richard Belzer.

Title: 122. Love at the Top
description: A cynical tragicomedy focusing on the different ways of love in the times of the sexual revolution.

Title: 123. Chosen Survivors
description: A group of diverse individuals are suddenly taken from their homes and flown via helicopter to a futuristic bomb shelter in the desert, one-third of a mile below the surface of the Earth. There, they learn that a nuclear holocaust is taking place and that they've been "chosen" by computer to survive in the shelter in order to continue the human race. The shelter is designed to allow the people to exist underground comfortably for years, but they are faced with a threat nobody could have predicted: a colony of thousands of bloodthirsty vampire bats finds a way into the shelter and launches a series of vicious attacks where they claim the humans one by one.

Title: 124. The Shameless
description: A manufacturer from Milan goes on vacation with his wife Clara and his teenage daughter. In the same hotel stays Fabio Lorenzi, a writer without inspiration and with a depressive crisis, who years before had been Clara's lover.

Title: 125. Spasmo
description: Young couple interrupted during intimacy by disturbing discovery of a mutilated mannequin at beach ruins. Mysterious man present flees before being questioned, leaving couple unsettled and the night's events unresolved.

Title: 126. Craze
description: An antiques dealer who leads a pagan cult to worship an African idol starts to go out of control, and begins sacrificing women to his deity.

Title: 127. Lady Snowblood 2: Love Song of Vengeance
description: To avoid a death sentence for her prior acts of bloodshed, the vengeful swordswoman Lady Snowblood is conscripted by the Japanese Secret Police to assassinate political dissidents.

Title: 128. The Night of the Sorcerers
description: When a research expedition encroaches upon a forbidden sacrificial site in the African jungle, a predatory cult of resurrected sorcerers targets the intruders. The party must survive the relentless pursuit of vampire women.

Title: 129. Who?
description: After an American scientist is severely injured and scarred in a car crash along the border with East Germany, he is captured by East German military. The scientists use metal implants to save him. Once he's back in the States, no one can tell if it's really him, so an intelligence specialist must determine who is under the "mask".

Title: 130. Boss Nigger
description: Two black bounty hunters, pursuing an outlaw, take over a small Western town without a sheriff.

Title: 131. Cockfighter
description: In the Deep South, a veteran cockfighter vows to remain silent until one of his birds wins a championship, and gambles with his loves and possessions to make ends meet.

Title: 132. The Mouth Agape
description: Monique is dying. Around her gather her unfaithful husband, her son, who is like his father, and her daughter-in-law. We observe them playing with life as she dies.

Title: 133. Himiko
description: A freestyle, imagined telling of the life of shaman queen Himiko, who falls in love with her half-brother, making her powers weaken thus putting her position to risk.

Title: 134. A Hard Day for Archie
description: Sex comedy about Archie Anders, a horny teen who can't help but think about sex all day. When even his own sister starts looking attractive to him, Archie realizes it's high time to leave the house and find the right girl for himself.

Title: 135. The Tournament
description: A Chinese martial arts instructor lets two of his students participate in a Thai boxing tournament, in order to pay off some debt. When they get badly defeated, and he's shunned by his peers, his daughter vows to correct his mistake.

Title: 136. The Traveler
description: A grade-school-age boy, neglected by his parents, lies, cheats, and steals to accumulate enough money to afford a bus ride to a large city and a ticket to see his favorite soccer team play.

Title: 137. Ghost in the Noonday Sun
description: In the 17th century, a pirate captain is murdered by his cook after he buries his treasure and marks it on a map but the poor-memory cook must rely on the captain's ghost to re-track the loot, since the map was drawn in disappearing ink.

Title: 138. Lesbian August
description: A young girl goes with her father and stepmother, with whom she has a lesbian affair, for vacation on a small island and a local fisherman gets between the two lovers.

Title: 139. The Stupid Millionaire
description: The funny treasure hunt of 4 rural brothers in Istanbul, after the recent death of their father who left them a treasure map as heritage.

Title: 140. Emma, puertas oscuras
description: Emma (Susanna East) is taken in by Dr. Sylvia Keane (Perla Cristal) after a traumatic accident changes her life, forcing them into a fragile relationship where care, control, and fear collide.

Title: 141. Bambina
description: An older man plans to marry a mentally-challenged, sex-crazed, adolescent girl.

Title: 142. Venial Sin
description: During a 1956 Italian beach holiday, a restless adolescent becomes infatuated with his older brother's captivating new wife, triggering a dangerous game of desire and coming-of-age transgression.

Title: 143. Escort Girls
description: It is Christmas Eve in London, and various lonely men and women turn to male and female escorts for company.

Title: 144. Mr. Majestyk
description: Vince Majestyk wants nothing more than to save his harvest, but his stubborn refusal to bend collides with organized criminals, forcing him to choose between protecting his livelihood and surviving a growing campaign of violence.

Title: 145. Julia
description: Pauli is a sexually frustrated young man who's surrounded by sexually liberated women who will not give him the time of day. He meets a beautiful virgin woman, Andrea, who strongly resists his charms, which compounds his frustrations.

Title: 146. Deranged
description: A deranged rural farmer becomes a grave robber and murderer after the death of his possessive mother, whose corpse he keeps, among others, as his companion in a decaying farmhouse.

Title: 147. His Mother's House
description: After breaking up from his studies Petter and his fiancee, he comes back to his home town and mother. Mother takes him in with great enthusiasm, because she wants him all to herself - in all ways.

Title: 148. Open Season
description: Three young men take a young woman and a middleaged man to an isolated cabin, where they are terrorized in different ways.

Title: 149. Got It Made
description: Drama set in Norfolk, England. An aristocratic girl whose world falls apart three days before her wedding. She discovers the hideous truths about the people closest to her - and her upbringing and background leave her unable to cope.

Title: 150. Blood for Dracula
description: An ailing vampire count travels to Italy with his servant to find a bride.

Title: 151. The Beast Must Die
description: Eight people are invited to an island estate for the weekend. One of them is a werewolf. Can you guess which one?

Title: 152. Confessions of a Young American Housewife
description: An attractive but conservative mid-40's housewife stays at the house of her sexually open daughter and soon becomes involved in her daughter's swinger lifestyle.

Title: 153. Candy Stripe Nurses
description: Young, pretty nurses and their hospital adventures.

Title: 154. The Swinging Cheerleaders
description: A college journalist infiltrates the campus' cheerleading squad to write an piece on female exploitation, but instead makes unlikely friendships and uncovers a conspiracy involving the football team's coach.

Title: 155. The Demoniacs
description: A gang of pirates rape the two sole survivors of a ship wreck. The violated girls are rescued by the strange inhabitants of a supposedly haunted island, where they are granted supernatural powers to strike revenge against the pirates.

Title: 156. Wide Open
description: Philandering taxi-driver Paul decides to help his girlfriend Marianne's attractive sister Beryl, who is in trouble with drug dealers.

Title: 157. Lorna . . . the Exorcist
description: As her eighteenth birthday nears, an impressionable young woman confronts erotic visions of a supernatural seductress, while her guilt-ridden father races to protect the family from a pact that threatens his daughter's body and autonomy.

Title: 158. Deadly Weapons
description: After the mob hits a guy with a list, one of the hoods keeps it for himself. When the mobsters find out he's a double-crosser, they off him, which angers his busty girlfriend. She goes after them using the only two weapons she has.

Title: 159. Where the Red Fern Grows
description: Where the Red Fern Grows is the heartwarming and adventurous tale for all ages about a young boy and his quest for his own redbone hound hunting dogs.

Title: 160. Mame
description: Following the death of his father, an orphan is sent to live with his free-spirited aunt.

Title: 161. House on the Rocks
description: A handsome stepson visits his mother, a mature archaeologist living in a fishing house overlooking the sea. Their unexpected encounter sparks unwanted thoughts and sinful desires.

Title: 162. Where the Lilies Bloom
description: A family of Appalachian children live together in the backwoods so that they can stay together after the death of their widower father.

Title: 163. Mama's Dirty Girls
description: Mama loves men, but she loves money even more. She's trained her three teenage daughters to meet, marry, and murder men for their money. But soon they meet Harold and he's got other plans.

Title: 164. The Sister in Law
description: Robert and Edward are brothers involved in a web of adultry and deceit. They share Edward's wife and his mistress and a mission to deliver a package of jewels across the Canadian border, but the mission turns out to be deadly.

Title: 165. House of Whipcord
